verdict.rationale: Fathom documents registrable webhooks that POST each new meeting's content, optionally including action items, to a URL of your choice, with signature verification. It also offers a REST API, SDKs and an official MCP server, so an agent can receive action items automatically per meeting. However, no native integration or automation into Linear, Jira or Asana is evidenced, so the filing step must be built by the user's own agent or code. Missing for 10: native project-tracker integrations/automations (Linear, Jira, Asana), a documented action-item payload schema, independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end tracker workflow.
